name: Clawbot KPI Dashboard
description: M20 omnichannel analytics dashboard for daily KPI, funnel, CPL trend, and cached forecasts.

cards.name: Omnichannel KPI by Platform
cards.query: SELECT date, platform, leads, dms, replies, conversions, avg_response_time_sec, ad_spend FROM dbo.kpi_daily ORDER BY date DESC, platform;

cards.name: Funnel Totals
cards.query: SELECT platform, SUM(leads) AS leads, SUM(dms) AS dms, SUM(replies) AS replies, SUM(conversions) AS conversions FROM dbo.kpi_daily GROUP BY platform ORDER BY platform;

cards.name: CPL Trend
cards.query: SELECT date, platform, CASE WHEN leads > 0 AND ad_spend IS NOT NULL THEN ad_spend / leads END AS cpl FROM dbo.kpi_daily WHERE ad_spend IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date, platform;

cards.name: 7-Day Forecast
cards.query: SELECT forecast_date, platform, metric, value, lower_bound, upper_bound, generated_at FROM dbo.kpi_forecast ORDER BY forecast_date, platform, metric;
